title: Front Cover
content: A Mediterranean brown trout (Salmo trutta complex) from a Pyrenean river in Catalonia (NE Spain), representative of the native southwestern European lineages. This cover image relates to Research Article “Conservation challenges under taxonomic uncertainty: introgression patterns and environmental correlates in Mediterranean brown trout”, [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70269] by Aparicio et al. Photo credit: Enric Aparicio.
